issues.finding: Person JSON-LD schema in layouts/partials/extend_head.html used relative image URL "/vesviet.png", contained self-referential /about/ in sameAs array, lacked explicit @id in ProfilePage.mainEntity, and layouts/partials/head.html exempted /about/ from emitting BreadcrumbList schema.
issues.remediation: Updated extend_head.html to use absolute image URL "https://tanhdev.com/vesviet.png", added @id: "https://tanhdev.com/#person" to Person object in ProfilePage.mainEntity, removed circular /about/ from sameAs array, and removed head.html line 193 exemption so /about/ receives proper BreadcrumbList schema.

issues.finding: 26 cataloged markdown files in content/ had title: frontmatter strings exceeding 60 characters, causing SERP truncation in search results.
issues.remediation: Trimmed frontmatter title: across all 26 cataloged files to high-CTR 50-60 character titles (e.g., "Tech Radar: DigitalOcean AI-Native Cloud & Inference Routing" [60 chars], "OSRM vs GraphHopper: Routing Engine Architecture Comparison" [60 chars]). Verification confirmed 0 titles > 60 chars sitewide across 299 markdown files.

issues.finding: 51 cataloged markdown files (plus terms-of-service, 53 total) had description: frontmatter strings exceeding 160 characters, causing search snippet tail truncation.
issues.remediation: Trimmed frontmatter description: across all 53 markdown files to 130-155 characters (strictly <= 160 chars). Verification confirmed 0 meta descriptions > 160 chars sitewide across 299 markdown files.

issues.finding: 112 blog post markdown files contained body # Heading tags outside code blocks, generating duplicate <h1> elements alongside PaperMod's <h1 class="post-title"> layout template.
issues.remediation: Converted all body # Heading tags outside code fences from # to ## (H2) across 112 blog posts in content/posts/, content/series/, content/radar/, and content/. Verification confirmed 0 body H1 tags remaining.

issues.remediation: Created 3 standalone legal pages with full regulatory disclosures (privacy-policy.md covering GA4 Consent Mode v2, Google AdSense, GDPR/CCPA rights, 90d/14m retention; terms-of-service.md covering MIT code licensing, engineering advisory disclaimer, AI crawler indexing rules; legal-notice.md covering Impressum for Lê Tuấn Anh, E-E-A-T zero synthetic fabrication policy, SLA). Added [[menu.footer]] to hugo.toml, updated layouts/partials/footer.html to dynamically iterate footer links, and added CSS flexbox rules in assets/css/extended/custom.css.
